findings.summary: First doc comment (before @deprecated) uses past tense 'was intended to define' where Scala style mandates present tense; prefer 'Defines an external name for a definition (deprecated; use [[targetName]] instead).'

Class doc comment repeats the same past-tense framing ('was intended to define', 'would be implemented under'); present tense is preferred even for deprecated APIs - the @deprecated annotation already signals the status.
@param description uses past tense ('was intended to be implemented'); a shorter present-tense phrase is cleaner, e.g. 'the external name for the annotated definition'.
